title: Crypto's longtime foe, North Korea's Lazarus Group, likely behind Binance hack: blockchain sleuths
reason: Attribution of the record hack to Lazarus Group is a significant new fact, corroborated by three sources including named intelligence firms.

sources.summary: Security researchers suggested that the hermit kingdom's Lazarus Group was behind Thursday's nearly $6 billion hack of the world's largest crypto exchange.
TRM Labs says it has high confidence in the attribution, while ZachXBT identified stolen funds from the Binance and Bitget hacks converging at the same address.

title: Here’s how an Ethereum upgrade helped drain part of Binance’s $6 billion loss
reason: Adds genuinely new facts on the hack mechanism via an Ethereum upgrade, a material development beyond the initial breach report.

sources.summary: On Ethereum, the attacker used a 2025 upgrade built to make ordinary wallets smarter, armed with 50 signatures from Binance's own wallet.
